prompt: A whimsical, decorative house by the sea on a small hill, surrounded by swirling ocean waves and enormous sky-reaching flowers in a Marimekko-inspired style. Romantic summertime atmosphere at sunrise, with dreamy Cinque Terre, Italy vibes. The painting features bold, thick, sloppy brush strokes, with strong texture and visible marks--impasto style using oil, acrylic, and gouache. Naive art meets dreamy minimalism, full of emotion and warmth. Romantic colors and soft light create a magical, serene mood. Inspired by the styles of Sophie Blackall, Maud Lewis, Maira Kalman, Chagall, Van Gogh, Monet, and Matisse. A unique, high-quality, ultrasharp masterpiece with vibrant expression, trending on ArtStation. Minimalist yet deeply expressive. Perfect composition and detail, like a breathtaking, emotional dream. --ar 1:1 --profile 4mzyewa --v 7
